title: Soccer Blitz 2D
description: Jump into fast-paced 2D arcade soccer duels—sprint, leap for power kicks, outmaneuver your rival on a lively stadium pitch, and smash goals before the buzzer.
controls: Use on-screen movement, jump, and kick controls (or keyboard arrows/buttons) to dribble, volley, and score past the rival.

zh-CN.title: 足球快斗
zh-CN.description: 快节奏 2D 街机足球大乱斗：一分钟一局随时开踢，腾空倒钩大力抽射破门，体验拳拳到肉的爆爽绿茵对决！
zh-CN.controls: 点击屏幕左右移动、跳跃与射门按钮，抢断凌空抽射攻破对手球门。
